purpose: Hand-curated seed examples per category. Used to bootstrap the persona-script spot-check pipeline (PR_1C_PLAN §1.7.2 step 3) before live scraped questions arrive. The real spot-check sample (30 questions stratified across the six categories) will replace this file's role once it's generated in PR 1.C.A.7.
_note_to_aayan: Use this as the spot-check seed when reviewing classifier category boundaries. Each category has 5-7 examples. The ambiguous_examples section tests two things: (a) the rule of thumb that meta_motivational is rarely the focus of an ambiguous coaching question — the classifier should lean toward the substantive category at moderate confidence (0.5-0.7) rather than default-routing; (b) genuinely non-coaching questions still default-route correctly. See the RULE OF THUMB section in categoryPrompts.ts.

ambiguous_examples.question: Should I trade queens here or study endgames?
ambiguous_examples.expected_outcome: improvement_strategy OR position_analysis at moderate confidence (0.5-0.7)
ambiguous_examples.why_ambiguous: Split between position_analysis ('trade queens here') and improvement_strategy ('study endgames'). Neither candidate is the meta_motivational default, so the rule of thumb doesn't directly apply — the classifier should pick whichever feels like the focus (improvement_strategy is plausible since 'study' is the active verb) and assign moderate confidence rather than default-route.

ambiguous_examples.question: I'm always confused about pawn structures
ambiguous_examples.why_ambiguous: Surface frustration ('always confused') reads like meta_motivational, but the substantive topic is pawn structures (concept_explanation). The rule of thumb says lean toward the non-default — classify as concept_explanation at ~0.6, not meta_motivational at 0.4.

ambiguous_examples.question: Walk me through what to do here and how I could have avoided getting here
ambiguous_examples.expected_outcome: position_analysis OR game_review at moderate confidence (0.5-0.7)
ambiguous_examples.why_ambiguous: Split between position_analysis ('what to do here') and game_review ('how I got here'). Neither is the meta_motivational default, so the rule of thumb doesn't directly apply — pick whichever feels like the focus (position_analysis is plausible since 'what to do' is the active ask) at moderate confidence rather than default-routing.

ambiguous_examples.question: What
ambiguous_examples.why_ambiguous: Not a coaching question at all. Confidence should be very low; default-route to meta_motivational is correct here — this is exactly the kind of case the default is for.
